_meta.notes: CHUNK-FILE FLAG CONFIRMED AT THE PAGE: the 'Office Sought' and 'District Number' cells are BOTH BLANK on the cover; the office is read from the top-row 'Office' cell, which reads 'Salt Lake County Auditor' (written on two lines). Form title prints '2016 Financial Disclosure Report For a Candidate' (form_year 2016). YEAR-END box checked; neither amendment box ticked, so is_amendment is honestly blank. Signature date reads '30 Jan 2017' (chunk file 2017-01-30 agrees); the clerk RECEIVED stamp is JAN 31 2017. Both schedules exist and are blank - this filing is a genuine zero-activity year-end, NOT an untranscribed one.
